evidence_items.explanation: The experiments support distinguishing apparent task competence from coherent representations and transfer. They do not establish the claimed absence in November 2025 GPT or compare it with seven-year-olds.

The Othello experiments found a usable internal board representation in a specially trained GPT variant. This challenges a blanket absence-of-representations reading, but does not demonstrate a contemporary GPT model with a child's broad understanding.

unresolved_gaps: No located study establishes the full comparison between November 2025 GPT and representative seven-year-olds across physical, social and bodily reasoning.
The representation studies concern earlier, restricted experimental systems.
The claim supplies no threshold separating a rich but imperfect world model from 'faking it'.
Experimental collection dates are not supplied in the cited abstracts; their event dates are recorded only at year precision.
